story.text: 승객 여러분, 이번 여정의 마지막, 지리산 상공이에요. 산이 품은 고요한 쉼을 함께 느껴보아요.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, i-beon yeo-jeong-ui ma-ji-mak, ji-ri-san sang-gong-i-e-yo. san-i pum-eun go-yo-han swim-eul ham-kke neu-kkyeo-bo-a-yo.
story.en: Passengers, this is the final stop of our journey, above Jirisan. Let's feel the quiet rest the mountain holds together.

story.text: 저 웅장한 산줄기, '지리산'이에요. 우리나라에서 손꼽히게 크고 넓어서 예로부터 많은 사람의 마음을 품어주었지요.
story.reading: jeo ung-jang-han san-jul-gi, ji-ri-san-i-e-yo. u-ri-na-ra-e-seo son-kkob-hi-ge keu-go neol-beo-seo ye-ro-bu-teo manh-eun sa-ram-ui ma-eum-eul pum-eo-ju-eot-ji-yo.
story.en: That majestic mountain range is 'Jirisan'. Being one of the largest and widest in our country, it has long embraced the hearts of many people.

story.text: 지리산 자락에는 오래된 '산사'가 자리해요. 산속 깊이 자리 잡아 고요함이 가득한 절을 산사라고 부른답니다.
story.reading: ji-ri-san ja-rag-e-neun o-rae-doen san-sa-ga ja-ri-hae-yo. san-sok gip-i ja-ri jab-a go-yo-ham-i ga-deuk-han jeol-eul san-sa-ra-go bu-reun-dam-ni-da.
story.en: At the foot of Jirisan sits an old 'mountain temple'. A temple nestled deep in the mountains, full of quietness, is called a sansa.

story.text: 요즘은 이 산사에서 '템플스테이'를 할 수 있어요. 하루나 며칠 동안 절에 머물며 몸과 마음을 쉬게 하는 특별한 체험이지요.
story.reading: yo-jeum-eun i san-sa-e-seo tem-peul-seu-te-i-reul hal su it-seo-yo. ha-ru-na myeo-chil dong-an jeol-e meo-mul-myeo mom-gwa ma-eum-eul swi-ge ha-neun teuk-byeol-han che-heom-i-ji-yo.
story.en: Nowadays, you can do a 'templestay' at this mountain temple. It's a special experience of staying at a temple for a day or several days to let your body and mind rest.

story.text: 산사에는 수행하는 '스님'이 계세요. 새벽부터 예불을 드리며 고요한 하루를 시작하신답니다.
story.reading: san-sa-e-neun su-haeng-ha-neun seu-nim-i gye-se-yo. sae-byeok-bu-teo ye-bul-eul deu-ri-myeo go-yo-han ha-ru-reul si-jak-ha-sin-dam-ni-da.
story.en: At the mountain temple, there are 'monks' who practice. They begin a quiet day with dawn prayer services.

story.text: 예불 시간이면 '목탁' 소리가 울려 퍼져요. 나무로 만든 이 악기 소리를 따라 마음이 차분히 가라앉는답니다.
story.reading: ye-bul si-gan-i-myeon mok-tak so-ri-ga ul-lyeo peo-jyeo-yo. na-mu-ro man-deun i ak-gi so-ri-reul tta-ra ma-eum-i cha-bun-hi ga-ra-anj-neun-dam-ni-da.
story.en: During prayer time, the sound of the 'moktak' rings out. Following the sound of this wooden instrument, the mind settles calmly.

story.text: 자, 고요한 다섯 단어와 함께 오늘 여정을 마무리해요. 이제 마음을 담아 문제를 풀어볼까요!
story.reading: ja, go-yo-han da-seot dan-eo-wa ham-kke o-neul yeo-jeong-eul ma-mu-ri-hae-yo. i-je ma-eum-eul dam-a mun-je-reul pul-eo-bol-kka-yo!
story.en: Now, let's wrap up today's journey with five quiet words. Let's solve some questions with a full heart!

words.example: 능선을 따라 걷다 보면 절이 나타납니다.
words.example_reading: neung-seon-eul tta-ra geot-da bo-myeon jeol-i na-ta-nam-ni-da
words.example_en: If you walk along the ridge, a temple appears.
A mountain temple is a temple located in the mountains.
During a templestay, you spend a day at a temple.
The monk holds a prayer service every morning.
You steady your mind to the sound of the moktak.

sentences.en: Jirisan was designated as national park No. 1.
A mountain temple is a quiet, peaceful place.
Templestay lets the body and mind rest.
The monk starts the day from dawn.
The moktak's sound softly spreads through the mountain temple.
